# Sprint N Goal

> Extracted from `breakdown-plan.prompt.md` (Sprint section).

## Sprint Template

- **Primary Objective**: {Main deliverable for this sprint}
- **Stories in Sprint**: comma-separated story issue links.
- **Sprint Goal Statement**: One sentence tying the objective to the epic outcome.

## Success Metrics

### Project Management KPIs

| Metric | Target |
|| ------ | ------ ||
| Sprint Predictability | >80% of committed work completed |
| Cycle Time | <5 business days (In Progress → Done) |
| Lead Time | <2 weeks (Backlog → Done) |
| Defect Escape Rate | <5% of stories require post-release fixes |
| Team Velocity | Consistent story point delivery across sprints |

### Process Efficiency Metrics

| Metric | Target |
|| ------ | ------ ||
| Issue Creation Time | <1 hour for full feature breakdown |
| Dependency Resolution | <24 hours for blocking dependencies |
| Status Update Accuracy | >95% automated transitions correct |
| Documentation Completeness | 100% issues have required template fields |
| Cross-Team Collaboration | <2 business days for external dependency resolution |

### Project Delivery Metrics

| Metric | Target |
|| ------ | ------ ||
| Definition of Done Compliance | 100% of completed stories meet DoD |
| Acceptance Criteria Coverage | 100% validated |
| Sprint Goal Achievement | >90% delivered |
| Stakeholder Satisfaction | >90% approval |
| Planning Accuracy | <10% variance estimate vs actual |
